boundary: Demo behavior is public and inspectable. Private prompts, routes, bridges, operating-core code and credentials are not present.
live_upgrade: Separate verified developer boundary; not implemented by this browser demo.
symbolic_boundary: Psychomatrix preview is symbolic/numerological and is not a psychometric assessment, diagnosis, fate claim or empirical personality measurement.
time_precision_boundary: When birth time is unknown, 12:00 is an explicit demo assumption and time-sensitive astrology claims are withheld.
human_team_boundary: Human Loop is self-report reflection, not diagnosis. Team Friction is operational context, not HR assessment or employee profiling.
safety_boundary: Violence, threat, harassment, coercion, self-harm or immediate-safety signals stop ordinary optimization and route to a responsible human boundary.
knowledge_boundary: Topology suggests where to look; it is not factual proof, a source browser or a private specialist API.
